channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Dino abre apuração sobre emendas a produtora de filme após áudio de Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino has ordered the opening of a separate investigation into parliamentary amendments by Bolsonarist deputies directed to the production company behind the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays the trajectory of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The move follows the release of an audio involving Dino that raised suspicions of potential irregular favoritism. The inquiry aims to determine whether public funds were misused or improperly allocated.

item.title: São Paulo acerta retorno de velho conhecido para comando técnico
item.description: Dorival Júnior is São Paulo's new head coach, returning for his third stint at the club after agreeing to a R$2 million annual salary through 2026. He replaces Roger Machado, who was sacked following the team's Copa do Brasil elimination, and arrives with São Paulo in the G4 of the Brasileirão and qualified for the Sudamericana knockout stage.

item.title: Médica ‘adoradora de Lula’, ‘marxistas drogados’, ‘pílulas mágicas’ de Damares: veja detalhes do roteiro de Dark Horse
item.description: The script of the film Dark Horse, sponsored by Daniel Vorcaro, features fictional scenes that associate political opponents of Jair Bolsonaro with negative stereotypes, such as a nurse described as a 'Lula worshiper' and the attacker, Adélio Bispo, portrayed under the fictional name Aurélio Barba as linked to 'drugged Marxists'. The film also references 'magic pills' tied to former minister Damares Alves. The content reflects a polarized narrative blending historical facts with conspiracy theories and dramatization.

item.title: Áudio: Lei institui Dia Nacional de Mobilização em Memória das Vítimas de Trânsito
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed Law 15.403/2026, establishing the National Mobilization Day in Memory of Traffic Victims, to be observed annually on the third Sunday of November. The law originated from Bill 382/2026 and was published in the Official Gazette on March 11, 2026.

item.title: Ao lado de Ruas, Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter pedido dinheiro a Vorcaro quando banqueiro era 'cortejado' por autoridades
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he sought financial help from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to fund the film 'Dark Horse' when the banker was widely 'courted' by authorities. The comment was made during the delivery of equipment to the Rio de Janeiro Military Police, alongside gubernatorial pre-candidate Douglas Ruas and other PL allies. Federal Police are investigating whether the funds were used to finance Eduardo Bolsonaro’s stay in the U.S., while protesters at the event questioned the 'Master money'.

item.title: Não faltam razões para Flávio Bolsonaro desidratar, mas suas redes sociais cresceram desde quarta
item.description: Despite the serious revelation regarding the close ties between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro, bolsonarism did not immediately retreat from its core support — at least not yet. The article is exclusive to subscribers, restricting full access to the analysis. Social media growth since Wednesday indicates resilience within Bolsonaro’s base despite the scandal.

item.title: Vaivém retórico de Flávio Bolsonaro aprofunda dúvidas sobre destino do dinheiro de Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s pre-candidate for president, faced backlash after admitting he received 61 million reais from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to fund the film Dark Horse about Jair Bolsonaro — despite initially denying any connection. He claims the money went to a U.S.-based fund managed by an attorney for Eduardo Bolsonaro, but provided no proof of the funds’ actual use, raising concerns about potential misuse, especially after Deputy Mário Frias and production company GOUP Entertainment denied Vorcaro’s involvement in the project.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Zema 'se precipitou' ao criticá-lo por áudio a Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema of acting hastily in criticizing him over messages in which he requested money from banker Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio stated he does not need to justify seeking private investment for the film and claimed Zema was misled by rushing to speak first. He later confirmed receiving R$ 61 million from Vorcaro, initially denying the request and then asserting the funding was entirely private.

item.title: Documentário sobre Bolsonaro estreia com sessões vazias, exalta ex-presidente, ignora Michelle e omite derrota e tentativa de golpe
item.description: The documentary 'A Colisão dos Destinos', about Jair Bolsonaro, premiered to nearly empty theaters, praising the ex-president while omitting Michelle Bolsonaro, his electoral defeat, and the January 8 coup attempt. Produced by Mario Frias with input from Eduardo Bolsonaro, it promises a 'humanized version' but avoids key facts from his administration.

item.title: Contratos Master: Flávio deu explicações capengas; Alexandre de Moraes, nem isso
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro gave an interview on GloboNews attempting to explain his request for funds from Daniel Vorcaro, claiming it was for the production of the film 'Dark Horse' and that he was unaware of Vorcaro's criminal activities, though his explanation left many loose ends. In contrast, Minister Alexandre de Moraes has remained silent regarding his ties to Vorcaro through his wife, offering no public justification. Both figures are linked to contracts potentially worth around R$ 130 million, revealing a pattern of cross-political financing through the same financial intermediary.

item.title: Por Dentro das Eleições: saiba como funciona a aplicação dos recursos de campanha
item.description: The use of campaign resources in Brazil is governed by TSE Resolution No. 23.607/2019, which mandates the use of dedicated bank accounts, identification of resource origins, itemization of expenses, and annual and electoral financial reporting to ensure transparency and oversight by the Electoral Justice. Parties may use funds from the Party Fund, individual donations, or personal resources, provided they are previously registered and transferred to the 'Campaign Donations' account.

item.title: Tarcísio foi pego de surpresa por diálogos de Flávio com Vorcaro e questionou gestão de crise, dizem aliados
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas questioned the campaign's crisis management after learning that Flávio Bolsonaro negotiated with Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse' without his prior knowledge, causing a breach of trust. Sources indicate Tarcísio criticized the lack of preparedness to respond to the allegations and emphasized the need for ongoing clarifications from Flávio.

item.title: Operação da PF contra Castro deixa aliados em estado de alerta
item.description: The Federal Police launched an operation against former Rio governor Cláudio Castro (PL), putting his allies on alert in the state legislature. The move intensifies fears of further investigations targeting figures from Castro’s political circle, following arrests of Bacellar, TH Joias, and Thiago Rangel. The climate of distrust impacts Rio’s succession race and the legislature’s reputation, already under scrutiny by the Supreme Court.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: O dilema de Flávio Bolsonaro e a PF em cima de Castro
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program examines Flávio Bolsonaro's dilemma as he attempts to distance himself from the Banco Master investigation, while the Federal Police conduct an operation targeting former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro. The segment highlights increasing pressure on figures aligned with Bolsonarism amid corruption probes and financial scheme allegations.

item.title: Os mistérios em torno dos próximos passos de Alcolumbre
item.description: Senators from the Centrão bloc are questioning the next steps of Senate President Davi Alcolumbre following the revelation of an unconventional relationship between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro, particularly regarding his alignment with the Lula government. Relations between Alcolumbre and the Planalto Palace have been strained since November, when Lula rejected his STF nominee in favor of Jorge Messias, who was later defeated by the Senate plenary. Despite the awkward encounter at the TSE inauguration — where Alcolumbre sat beside Lula after Senate defeats of the Executive — his potential rapprochement with the government remains uncertain.

item.title: Dino abre apuração sobre emendas destinadas a produtora de filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino has opened a confidential preliminary investigation into parliamentary amendments directed to the producer of the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays former President Jair Bolsonaro. The probe aims to examine potential irregularities in the allocation of public funds to the cinematic project.

item.title: Ibovespa despenca em meio a crise política e tensão nos mercados globais
item.description: The Ibovespa plummeted due to a mix of political uncertainty in Brazil, involving Flávio Bolsonaro’s alleged request for financing from Daniel Vorcaro, and international tensions, including the Federal Reserve leadership transition from Jerome Powell to Kevin Warsh. Investors reacted to global risk aversion, inflationary pressures, and lack of progress in Trump-Xi talks, triggering profit-taking and sell-offs in bank and retail stocks.

item.title: Dino abre investigação sobre emendas ligadas a filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino has ordered the opening of a formal proceeding to investigate the allocation of parliamentary amendments to entities linked to Karina Ferreira da Gama, executive producer of the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays the trajectory of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The move aims to scrutinize potential misuse of public funds for cinematic projects tied to political figures.

item.title: Dino abre apuração preliminar sobre emendas de deputados do PL a ONGs ligadas a produtora de filmes
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered a preliminary investigation into alleged irregularities in the allocation of parliamentary amendments to entities linked to the producer of the film 'Dark Horse', a biography of Jair Bolsonaro. The NGOs Instituto Conhecer Brasil and Academia Nacional de Cultura reportedly received approximately R$2.6 million in 'PIX' amendments from PL deputies including Alexandre Ramagem, Carla Zambelli, Bia Kicis, Marcos Pollon, and Mário Frias, with suspicions of misuse of public funds for indirect film financing and electoral marketing.

item.title: Enquanto Flávio tenta se safar, chefe de comunicação da campanha viaja aos EUA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign communications coordinator, Marcello Lopes (Marcelão), is in the United States amid a wave of troubles overwhelming the campaign. The article states that key figures linked to the controversy are also in the U.S. The content is exclusive to subscribers, requiring registration for full access.

item.title: A nova pesquisa AtlasIntel sobre Lula x Flávio após revelação de áudios para Vorcaro
item.description: AtlasIntel has registered a new national poll on the 2026 presidential race, conducted from May 13 to 18 following the controversy over audio recordings of Flávio Bolsonaro to Daniel Vorcaro. The survey interviewed 5,000 voters online, with a 1 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level, and will be released on May 19. It aims to assess whether Lula’s recent recovery has solidified or if the technical tie with Flávio persists, while also measuring the impact of the Vorcaro episode and the viability of alternative candidates such as Caiado and Zema.

item.title: Celso Amorim viaja à Rússia pela 5ª vez em Lula 3
item.description: Celso Amorim, special advisor to the Presidency, will travel to Russia for the fifth time during Lula’s third term to attend the 1st International Security Forum in Moscow from May 25 to 31. He will serve as a cybersecurity advisor and engage in diplomatic consultations, focusing on Iran, Venezuela and, secondarily, the war in Ukraine.

item.title: Inelegível até 2030, Cláudio Castro deixou o governo para evitar cassação; veja as investigações
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) was declared ineligible until 2030 by the TSE for abuse of political and economic power, linked to the creation of over 27,000 irregular commissioned positions at Ceperj and Uerj to boost his 2022 re-election. He resigned in March 2024 to avoid cassation, though the conviction stands. He is now under a new PF investigation regarding the Refit group and was previously probed for alleged corruption in the Fundação Leão XIII social programs during his time as vice-governor.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula visita o Hospital do Amor, em Barretos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Health Minister Alexandre Padilha visited the Hospital do Amor in Barretos (SP) to announce the construction of a new Clinical Research and Robotic Surgery Center, along with an Institute for Training in Minimally Invasive Surgery. The initiatives include a specific funding table for oncological robotic surgery in the SUS, delivery of new linear accelerators and patient transport vehicles via the Agora Tem Especialistas – Caminhos da Saúde program, aiming to expand free access to high-complexity cancer treatments.

item.title: Alvo de operação da PF, desembargador foi afastado pelo CNJ por decisões suspeitas envolvendo a Refit
item.description: Judge Guaraci de Campos Vianna, target of PF's Operation Sem Refino, had been suspended by the CNJ since March over suspicious rulings in the Refit judicial recovery case, including defying a STJ order and appointing a contested expert. The operation executed 17 search and seizure warrants and seven public function suspensions across RJ, SP, and DF, investigating fuel sector frauds, with Refit owner Ricardo Magro a fugitive and subject to preventive detention. The CNJ cited risk of harm to the public purse and public order due to the case's continuation in state court despite STJ suspension.

item.title: Flávio diz não saber exatamente quanto custou filme sobre Bolsonaro: ‘Algo em torno de US$ 16 mi’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he does not know the exact cost of the film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, but estimates it at around US$16 million, less than the US$24 million negotiated with Daniel Vorcaro. He said the fund receiving the investment is overseen by the U.S. stock exchange and denied sending money to his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro, noting that Jair Bolsonaro’s donation to Eduardo was for his sustenance in the United States.

item.title: Dólar dispara 1% nesta sexta com investidores atentos com cenário eleitoral
item.description: The dollar surged over 1% in early trading on Friday, surpassing R$ 5, as investors focused on political developments surrounding presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro and former banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Master Bank. The connection between the two has raised concerns about potential financial influence on the campaign, increasing market risk aversion. The volatility highlights the exchange rate’s sensitivity to political uncertainty ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Charge do JCaesar: 15 de maio
item.description: The JCaesar cartoon published on May 15, 2026 satirizes the relationship between Banco Master, Daniel Vorcaro, and Flávio Bolsonaro, implying political collusion or influence in the financial sector. The critical humor suggests possible influence peddling or illegitimate favoritism amid rising pre-election tensions in 2026.

item.title: Revelação sobre elo entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Daniel Vorcaro causa 'desgaste muito grande', diz Kassab
item.description: PSD national president Gilberto Kassab says revelations linking Flávio Bolsonaro to jailed banker Daniel Vorcaro are causing 'very great wear' to the senator's campaign, after audio and text messages showed Flávio asking Vorcaro for money to fund the film 'Dark Horse'. Kassab states the trend is for Flávio Bolsonaro to drop in voter intention polls.

item.title: Flávio diz que recursos foram usados “integralmente” em filme
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that the $24 million transferred by Daniel Vorcaro for the film 'Dark Horse' was fully used in production, denying Eduardo Bolsonaro received any funds. The Federal Police is investigating whether the money was used to support Eduardo in the U.S., but Flávio claims transparency due to SEC oversight of the Havengate fund and says he is a target of persecution and false narratives.

item.title: Flávio diz que gestor de fundo ligado a filme é advogado de Eduardo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that the manager of the fund linked to the film 'Dark Horse' is the lawyer of his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro, denying that Eduardo received financing from Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro. The Federal Police are investigating whether Vorcaro’s payments to the film were actually directed to Eduardo. Flávio said his brother survives in the U.S. with personal resources and denied any quid pro quo in his interactions with Vorcaro.

item.title: Após áudio de Vorcaro com Flávio Bolsonaro, André Mendonça marca reunião com a PF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça scheduled a meeting with the Federal Police to discuss leaks in Operation Compliance Zero, following the release of audios between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro regarding financing of a biopic on Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio confirmed the contacts but denied any quid pro quo, calling it a private negotiation. Vorcaro, imprisoned, is negotiating a plea deal that could implicate officials from all three branches of government.

item.title: Calendário oficial ganha Julho Neon para conscientização sobre saúde bucal
item.description: July has been officially designated as Oral Health Awareness Month in Brazil, establishing 'Julho Neon' through Law 15.408/2026, signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The law mandates nationwide educational campaigns and preventive actions throughout the month, aiming to reduce regional disparities in dental care access and promote oral hygiene habits. The initiative originated from Bill PL 2.563/2021 by Deputy Doutor Luizinho (PP-RR) and was approved following a favorable opinion by Senator Jussara Lima (PSD-PI).

item.title: JOTA Principal: Flávio Bolsonaro tenta se explicar de novo e reitera que dinheiro de Vorcaro ia só para filme
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro reiterated that the money transferred by Daniel Vorcaro was destined exclusively to a fund for the production of Jair Bolsonaro's biopic, denying any diversion to finance his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro or other purposes. He also denied having intimacy or discussing other matters with Vorcaro, stating their December 2024 meeting was solely for film sponsorship, while the PF investiges whether the funds were used to bankroll Eduardo Bolsonaro's campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai insistir no papel de quem esmola dinheiro de Vorcaro ou tomar outro caminho?
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro faces his first major electoral test after being caught requesting money from banker Daniel Vorcaro, who is under investigation for fraud, while attempting to frame the request as support for a film about his father. His defense contained contradictions: he initially denied the allegations, then claimed Vorcaro had no public allegations against him in 2024, but the request occurred in 2025 when Vorcaro was already under scrutiny. Film producers denied receiving any funds, raising questions about the money’s fate and undermining the candidate’s credibility among undecided voters.

item.title: Lula chamou Magro de 'grande chefe do crime organizado' e disse ter pedido prisão a Trump
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated he had requested assistance from U.S. President Donald Trump to arrest and deport Brazilian businessman Ricardo Magro, owner of Refit, whom he described as 'one of the biggest heads of organized crime in the country' and the nation's largest debtor. Lula said he had sent Trump a photograph of Magro's Miami home and details about operations that blocked 250 million liters of fuel linked to the company.

item.title: Operação da PF dificulta candidatura de Castro ao Senado
item.description: The Federal Police launched an operation against former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) over suspicions of tax fraud, asset concealment, and illicit resource outflow abroad, involving fuel sector companies. The searches, authorized by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, took place at his residence in Barra da Tijuca and worsen his already unviable electoral situation, following his 2030 ineligibility ruling by the TSE for abuse of power in the 2022 elections. His preemptive resignation was seen by the STF as an attempt to evade electoral sanctions, and the new police scrutiny further undermines any potential Senate bid in 2026.

item.title: Não temos nada a nos preocupar, a não ser com a perseguição, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, pre-candidate for presidency in 2026, stated that the only concern is persecution, denying any wrongdoing in his contacts with Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse'. He rejected allegations of quid pro quo, said the money was fully used for production, and called for a CPI to investigate Banco Master. Flávio also denied offering advantages in return or intermediating government deals.

item.title: Flávio diz que Zema “foi precipitado” e agradece apoio de Caiado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Romeu Zema for being 'hasty' in judging his messages with Daniel Vorcaro, saying the former Minas Gerais governor acted prematurely without hearing his side. He thanked Ronaldo Caiado for his support, noting Caiado urged him to explain but reaffirmed the right-wing goal of defeating Lula in 2026. Bolsonaro denied any wrongdoing in the messages and said he deserved the benefit of the doubt after his clarifications.

item.title: Cidadãos lideram ações na Justiça por acesso a dados públicos
item.description: Ordinary citizens are the primary petitioners in judicial disputes over access to public information in Brazil, accounting for 55.9% of the 22,702 decisions analyzed between 2012 and 2026. Most actions stem from public administration failures, particularly administrative silence (7,549 cases), with municipalities being the most challenged entities (11,477 decisions), highlighting weak local transparency and direct civic oversight of municipal affairs.

item.title: Quem é e o que já fez deputado que comprou briga com Fábio Porchat
item.description: State Deputy Rodrigo Amorim (PL), president of the Constitution and Justice Commission of Alerj, introduced a bill to declare comedian Fábio Porchat 'persona non grata' in Rio, in response to Porchat's criticisms of Bolsonaro allies and sketches involving religion and politics. Amorim gained national prominence in 2018 for breaking the plaque honoring Marielle Franco and was one of the most voted state deputies in Rio that election. His career is marked by conservative agendas, ideological clashes, and in 2024 he became the first Brazilian parliamentarian convicted of political gender violence for remarks against transgender councilwoman Benny Briolly.

item.title: Crusoé: O ressentimento de Flávio com Zema
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) responded to criticism from former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo), saying Zema was hasty in questioning his messages to banker Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master. Flávio stated he deserved the benefit of the doubt and would never act that way toward Zema, expressing resentment over the treatment.

item.title: Flávio diz que Jair Bolsonaro o aconselhou a falar a verdade e que Eduardo vive de doação do pai
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, said he spoke with his father, Jair Bolsonaro, about his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, revealed by The Intercept Brasil, and that the former president advised him to stay calm and tell the truth. He also stated that his brother Eduardo lives off donations from their father. The remarks were made on Friday, May 15, 2026.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro ainda tem muito a explicar sobre a relação com Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro failed to adequately explain the use of the US$61 million transferred by Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, whose relationship was revealed in audio leaks by The Intercept. Although he claims the funds were intended for a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro, he admitted the money passed through Havengate Development Fund, a company linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro’s lawyer, Paulo Calixto, based in Texas. Repeatedly changing narratives about the money’s purpose have raised suspicions of misuse, including potential funding for Eduardo’s stay in the United States.

item.title: Esquerda comemora operação de busca e apreensão da PF contra Cláudio Castro: 'Avisei que ia acontecer'
item.description: Federal Police conducted search and seizure operations against former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) as part of an investigation into a tax evasion scheme linked to the Refit group. The operation, authorized by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, also targeted businessman Ricardo Magro, with a request for inclusion in Interpol’s Red Notice. Left-wing figures including Marcelo Freixo, Anielle Franco, Tainá de Paula, and William Siri celebrated the move on social media, linking it to corruption and political ineligibility.

item.title: Governo Lula lucrou R$ 1,85 bilhão com taxa das blusinhas
item.description: The Lula government collected R$ 1.85 billion from the so-called 'blusinhas tax' — an import duty on low-value international purchases — in the first months of 2026, according to Federal Revenue data released by CNN. Despite the significant revenue, the government decided to abolish the measure, which had become a key source of income. The tax was criticized for affecting consumers of inexpensive foreign goods, particularly from platforms like Shopee and Shein.

item.title: Flávio diz que Bolsonaro nunca se encontrou com Vorcaro, do Banco Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that former President Jair Bolsonaro never met with banker Daniel Vorcaro during negotiations to finance the film 'Dark Horse', despite documented talks. He said the funds were directed to an investment fund managed by a lawyer and that there were no irregularities, estimating the total contributions at around US$ 16 million.

item.title: Lisboa terá maior colégio eleitoral fora do Brasil
item.description: Lisbon has become the largest Brazilian overseas electoral college for the 2026 elections, with 68,979 eligible voters — a 52.4% increase since 2022. The TRE-DF oversees the voting process with consular support, and in Lisbon, voting will take place across three University of Lisbon facilities, with an initial plan for 183 sections and 87 electronic ballot boxes. Portugal also hosts voting in Porto (5th largest) and Faro, reflecting the concentration of Brazilian voters in Europe, North America, and Japan.

item.title: Flávio diz que Zema foi ‘precipitado’ em crítica sobre relação com Vorcaro: ‘Merecia o benefício da dúvida’; assista
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) was 'precipitous' in criticizing him over alleged negotiations with banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse'. Flávio said he attempted to contact Zema and deserved the benefit of the doubt, emphasizing that funds were directed to an investment fund overseeing the film's production with no irregularities. He also praised Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) for his respectful stance.

item.title: Mário Frias contradiz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre relação com Vorcaro em filme
item.description: Federal Deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) issued a statement contradicting Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), who had admitted to maintaining a relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro linked to the financing of the film Dark Horse. Frias denied any involvement or knowledge of the alleged illicit financing, creating an internal conflict within the PL party over the matter. The disagreement arises amid investigations into potential irregularities in the use of public or private funds for film production tied to Bolsonarist figures.
